description: B2b arm: budget-allocation strategy prompt + harness deadline reminder. Measures whether the model can convert verified findings into a submitted diagnosis within budget. NOT autonomous search, NOT RSI evidence.

basetine.b2a_failure_mode: 0/3 proposals; diagnosis correct (rounds 6-7 exact lesion verification) but budget exhausted on z-anomaly sweep (r1-r5) and cross-projection checks (r8-r9)

b2b1_strategy_prompt.content_summary: budget template (1 scan + <=4 verify + >=1 propose) + evidence tiering (zero_rows=hard fingerprint, verify once then stop; z=soft signal, skip unless corroborating a fingerprint) + dedup rule (never re-query a confirmed finding)

b2b2_deadline_reminder.message: BUDGET WARNING: 2 calls remain. If your evidence already includes a verified zero_rows fingerprint, submit propose_edit NOW. Do not start new verification threads.
b2b2_deadline_reminder.note: reminder only - harness never submits on the model's behalf

b2b3_forced_fallback.trigger: final round reached without any proposal
b2b3_forced_fallback.message: FINAL CALL: budget exhausted. Output your best-current diagnosis as propose_edit NOW with whatever evidence you have.
b2b3_forced_fallback.statistics: reported separately as forced_proposal_rate; never merged with autonomous completion

preregistered_verdicts.pass_primary: >=2/3 runs with AUTONOMOUS final proposal naming up_proj (B2b-3 forced proposals excluded from this count)
preregistered_verdicts.pass_layer: >=2/3 autonomous proposals containing at least one of layers 22/28/30
preregistered_verdicts.secondary: forced-proposal correctness reported separately; duplicate-call waste <= 1 per run
